reviewer._note: pr_heads sends critic + blinky one line per new PR / head

arch1.reason: deep-review / Gate B ask for Arch1

forge.reason: CI / deploy failure, merge / deploy / Gate B run ask, or merge into main or bifrost/main

critic.reason: review request or Light / Strict / re-Light ask

blinky.reason: new issue or CoS / board ask for blinky

seats.critic: review ask: new PR or new head
seats.blinky: heads-up: new PR or new head

_note_pr_heads: every PR open / new head on a watched repo, mention or not; one line per seat per repo#number@sha (inbox_pass.py)
_note_extra_seats: extra_seats are routed by feed/inbox_pass.py (kinds / merge_bases / needles); every key is one of our 9 seats (feed/fleet-roster.json)
_note_builder_cloud: builder / builder-cloud are kit plumbing in app/server.mjs (installation-token auth, mirror); no route writes to them
_note_fallback: #275 + lap 2: actionable events whose lines all go to a seat outside our 9 (unknown, sample, unkeyed) or only to fallback.from (arch1, no webhook) also go to blinky (CoS). Lines to seats outside our 9 are dropped. Pulses never route.
_note_comment_watch: Every PR/issue comment (incl. merged PRs) routes to blinky, and PR/issue comments also to the PR or issue author's seat (aliases on the author node), mention or not. @-mentions come from the collector's mentions[] (handles only, never bodies).
_note_seats: seats: the kit's role rules (reviewer / builder / tester / operator / coord, read by routing/inbox.py), each mapped to one of our 9 by "seat" (or "off"); inbox_pass.py rewrites every line to that seat. Kit defaults stay in inbox.py.
